findings_raw.description: Together AI client is created without rate limit configuration, which could lead to excessive requests and higher costs.
findings_raw.remediation: Configure rate limiting on the Together AI client to control the request rate and avoid unexpected costs.

findings_raw.description: Together AI API calls lack idempotency keys, which could result in duplicate charges if requests are retried.
findings_raw.remediation: Add idempotency keys to Together AI API requests to prevent duplicate operations.

findings_raw.description: Together AI API responses are not cached, leading to repeated computation for identical requests and increased costs.
findings_raw.remediation: Implement caching for Together AI API responses to reduce redundant calls and lower costs.
